evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Since ternary judgements proved too coarse for objective annotation, relevance is decomposed into a cascade of four binary questions (same domain, activity mentioned, right granularity, replacement of a gold positive) that a smaller LLM judge can answer reliably; the labels are validated with blind human and frontier-model re-annotation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Graded labels expose much bigger gaps between top submissions and baselines than binary evaluation does, and show that semantic-understanding skill recommendation is still wide open.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Skill extraction benchmarks score models against a few human-annotated positives and treat every other skill in the vocabulary as equally wrong.
